name: Any game (generic)

validation.notes: Works on many games at a shallow level using the cloud vision recogniser. It knows nothing game-specific: it reads phases, deaths, results, visible scores and minimap areas only.

capture.notes: Capture the game window, not the whole desktop, so notifications and other apps stay out of the frames.

vision.purpose: This can be any video game. Report only what is plainly visible: the game phase, whether the player's own character visibly died or was eliminated (death screen, respawn timer, kill-cam of the player), visible round or match result banners, numbers on a visible scoreboard, the player's visible health bar, and, if a minimap is visible, which part of the minimap the player's marker was in at death. Never guess positions of anything not drawn on screen.

state.label: Player/team score
state.description: The player's (or player's team's) score on a visible scoreboard. Omit if you cannot tell which side is the player's.

state.label: Opponent score
state.description: The opposing side's score on a visible scoreboard.

state.label: Kills
state.description: The player's own kill count, only if shown on the HUD or scoreboard.

state.label: Deaths
state.description: The player's own death count, only if shown on the HUD or scoreboard.

events.label: Player died
events.description: The player's own character is visibly dead or eliminated in this frame (death screen, respawn countdown, 'eliminated' banner, kill-cam focused on the player).

attributes.description: Whether teammates were visibly close to the player just before death (only if visible).

events.label: Player got a kill
events.description: A kill-feed entry or banner shows the player eliminated an opponent in this frame.

zones.label: Minimap area
zones.description: Divide the visible minimap into a 3x3 grid as drawn on screen (top = north). Use the player's own marker position. If no minimap is visible, give no zone.

concepts.title: Deaths that cluster in one area
concepts.summary: When most deaths happen in the same part of the map, that area is worth reviewing: how you enter it, with whom, and what you can see before you commit.
good: Approach a risky area with teammates or information
bad: Repeating the same route into the same area alone

prohibitedAdvice: Anything about opponents that is not visible on the player's own screen
Exploits, glitches or anything against the game's rules
Game-specific tactics the generic pack has no knowledge of

limitations: Generic: no knowledge of this game's rules, maps or meta. Advice is limited to patterns in visible deaths, results and scores.
Frames are sampled every few seconds, so quick deaths and kills can be missed.
Minimap areas are approximate and only available when a minimap is on screen.
failClosed: No cloud vision: the generic pack sees nothing (it has no pixel rules).
Unclear whether the player or a teammate died: the event is not recorded.
